q1_issues.issue: The evaluative 'is no way to treat a lady' (= not an acceptable/proper way) is rendered as a flat denial that this is a way of treating a lady at all, which is not what the sentence claims.

q2_gaps: evaluative / normative predicate nominal 'is no way to V' — the negation targets propriety, not category membership, and no licensed carrier records that force
to-infinitive complement of a noun ('a way TO treat X') — the complement rule covers PP arguments of nouns and adjectives, not infinitival complements
notes: The multi-atom bundle denial, the antecedent-less pronoun witness (sk_thing_1 typed thing), and Theme for 'treat' all follow the instruction set, and the treat event carries no status atom so it asserts no occurrence. Head To on an entity symbol is a plausible extension of the (For <noun-symbol> <argument>) noun-complement form.
